biotools.summary: deepmriprep is a fast, deep learning preprocessing pipeline for Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM) analysis of T1-weighted MRI data. It uses GPUs to perform tissue segmentation and image registration, matching the accuracy of established toolboxes like CAT12.
